config-applies-text: ImmersiveWakes takes saved changes within half a second, on pause too: there is no need to re-enter the world.
config-disablemod-hint: No new wakes, rings or bow spray appear. The wakes already on the water fade out.
config-section-sources-text: SIMULATION_AND_PLANES: wake and bow spray. ONLY_SIMULATION: wake only. ONLY_PLANES: bow spray only. DISABLED: nothing. Bow spray needs a speed over 3 blocks a second (maxSplashPlaneVelocity 0.5 in the config file).
config-boatspawning-hint: Every boat except one that carries other players and not you: yours, an empty one or one with animals.
config-otherplayersspawning-hint: Other players swimming. A boat that carries other players and not you shows only what both this and Boats allow.
config-playerspawning-hint: Your character swimming or jumping into the water.
config-mobspawning-hint: Animals and other creatures in the water, ridden ones too.
config-itemspawning-hint: Items floating on the water and the fishing bobber.
config-projectilespawning-hint: Arrows, spears, thrown stones, snowballs and beenades ring the water where they fall in. They make no spray: ONLY_PLANES and DISABLED turn their rings off.
config-wakeopacity-hint: 1 draws the wake in full colour, 0 hides it.
config-blendstrength-hint: Higher values tint the see-through parts of the wake with the colour of the water under them. The solid crest keeps its own colour.
config-wakeresolution-hint: Simulation cells per block. 32 is expensive: its simulation takes several times the CPU of 16. A change clears the wakes on the water.
config-spawnparticles-hint: Spray clouds at the bow of whatever moves faster than 3 blocks a second where its setting above allows spray.
config-firstpersoneffects-hint: When off, the spray of your own character swimming is hidden while you look from first person. The spray of a boat or of a ridden animal always shows. It matters only when the setting You allows spray.
config-section-palette-text: Each colour has a picker: click the square for the palette, or type hex into the field. The slider under it is the opacity of that colour, from 0 (clear) to 255 (solid). The colours go from the deepest trough (1) through flat water (5) to the highest crest (9). In the config file a colour is #RRGGBB and its opacity sits in wakeColorAlphas; a colour written #AARRGGBB there is read too, its AA becomes the opacity.
